additional_info.subject: 0370207 - ID0370207-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / R4 312555359091] Charger is offline on SCB CRM:00641000604
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Abhinav
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
Y2 / R4 312555359091
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
lybjFN
Problem Description
:
Charger is offline on SCB
Troubleshooting
:
Unfortunately, we cannot do much remotely when we don't have SCB connection.
The best would be to have someone on site to check:
The router is connected to internet.
The charger is powered.
And kindly refer the below points which might be the reason to out the charger on SCB.
Then there might be Internet issue with the Siemens router and probably because of failover function the WAN is switched from Cellular to Ethernet.
I would recommend doing a Hard reset from "OCPP" (If charger is connected to OCPP server) or a local reboot will bring them up again.
Data service of mobile network operator might not be available.
- SIM card might be disabled / expired (Please check if the SIM card is inserted incorrectly by cleaning and then reinserting it into the XF3 and XF4 router.)
- monthly data volume exhausted
- signal strength got weak due to changed radio transmission conditions
- in case of M2M contracts is IP not enabled
There might be backend related issues.
- Backend changed the settings for the affected charger
- OCPP server on Backend side unavailable
It could be Teltonika related issues.
- Router switches to a wrong network service (e.g. 3G instead of 4G)
- Hardware failure of Router
- Router software crash
For future reference, your ticket number is
0370207
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav Malokar

additional_info.subject: 0370207 - ID0370207-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / R4 312555359091] Charger is offline on SCB CRM:00568000089
additional_info.body:
Bonjour,
Après intervention de geoffrey Guersing, le défaut est lié au déclenchement du fusible électronique FC13 ( 6A) qui supprime l'alimentation du switch 1 sur lequel le routeur est connecté.
Nous avons essayé de trouver d'où ce déclenchement pouvais provenir mais nous n'avons pas identifié de rootcause ( I = 350mA, tension 24V à la sortie du fusible) .
Après réenclenchement du fusible, le routeur est de nouveau fonctionnel.
Proposition de mettre sous surveillance jusqu'a la prochaine réunion ticketing du 09/09/24 . Si le défaut reapparait changer le fusible électronique
With best regards,
SEBASTIEN COLLET
Siemens SAS
